sourceText:
Vegetable Pasta
By: Anonymous
Published: Sunday, February 14, 2010 - 7:29am

Ingredients




1 tablespoon oil
1 onion, chopped
1 zucchini, sliced
1 cup broccoli, cut up
cup spaghetti sauce
parmesan cheese
1 zucchini, grated
cooked pasta

Preparation

1 Fry onion in oil. Add sliced zucchini and broccoli. cook 2 to 4 minutes. 2 Add spaghetti sauce and cook another 2 to 4 minutes. 3 Pour over cooked pasta. Add parmesan cheese on top and then the grated fresh zucchini.
